name: Ainan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ainan town emblem in blue and green: a blue stylised letter a of curved strokes with a green disc.
history: Municipal flag of Ainan, a town in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Ainan town emblem — a blue stylised letter a of curved strokes with a green disc
